qualification: cross-revision core-family and independent U52 class comparison; neither identifies the installed K7222.11 core or material

robotron.reading: The later horizontal stage names a U52/54 ferrite core in T3. The HV and basic windings are layer-wound; capacitance and inductance are tuned to the third harmonic of flyback. L4 compensates HV-winding leakage and C30 adjusts EHT and the third-harmonic tuning.
robotron.limit: No K7222.11 core type, material, effective geometry, air gap or winding map is stated. U52/54 is not proven identical to the independent catalog's U52.

fonox.limit: These are catalog U52/H21 set values and test conditions, not measured ÜHA78 or installed .11 properties. The catalog does not specify an intentional gap; its printed AL cannot transfer to an unmeasured flyback gap.
